content: Under three different perturbations, perturbing words of top-most importance leads to lower BLEU scores than Random selected words. It confirms the existence of important words, which have greater impacts on translation performance. Furthermore, perturbing important words identified by Attribution outperforms the Random method by a large margin (more than 4.0 BLEU under 5 operations).
